methods.label: Compare the magnitudes of the coefficients
methods.explanation: The smaller \(\lvert a\rvert\) is, the wider the opening. The values of \(\lvert a\rvert\) for the four functions are 2, 1, \(1/2\), and 3, respectively. The smallest is \(1/2\), so C has the widest opening.
